+#ifndef DWARF_REGS_RISCV64_H
+#define DWARF_REGS_RISCV64_H
+
+#define THREAD_CONTEXT_CLASS "sun/jvm/hotspot/debugger/riscv64/RISCV64ThreadContext"
+
+/*
+ * From the RISC-V ABIs Specification
+ *   https://riscv-non-isa.github.io/riscv-elf-psabi-doc/#_dwarf_register_numbers
+ *       DWARF Register Numbers
+ *
+ * DWARF register numbers 0-31 correspond to integer registers x0-x31.
+ * The hardware x0 is hardwired to zero and thus omitted here, as standard compiler-generated RISC-V frames never
+ * reference it for CFAs or return addresses.
+ * Consequently, register slot 0 in RISCV64ThreadContext is repurposed to store the PC.
+ */
+#define DWARF_REGLIST \
+  DWARF_REG(R1,   1) \
+  DWARF_REG(R2,   2) \
+  DWARF_REG(R3,   3) \
+  DWARF_REG(R4,   4) \
+  DWARF_REG(R5,   5) \
+  DWARF_REG(R6,   6) \
+  DWARF_REG(R7,   7) \
+  DWARF_REG(R8,   8) \
+  DWARF_REG(R9,   9) \
+  DWARF_REG(R10, 10) \
+  DWARF_REG(R11, 11) \
+  DWARF_REG(R12, 12) \
+  DWARF_REG(R13, 13) \
+  DWARF_REG(R14, 14) \
+  DWARF_REG(R15, 15) \
+  DWARF_REG(R16, 16) \
+  DWARF_REG(R17, 17) \
+  DWARF_REG(R18, 18) \
+  DWARF_REG(R19, 19) \
+  DWARF_REG(R20, 20) \
+  DWARF_REG(R21, 21) \
+  DWARF_REG(R22, 22) \
+  DWARF_REG(R23, 23) \
+  DWARF_REG(R24, 24) \
+  DWARF_REG(R25, 25) \
+  DWARF_REG(R26, 26) \
+  DWARF_REG(R27, 27) \
+  DWARF_REG(R28, 28) \
+  DWARF_REG(R29, 29) \
+  DWARF_REG(R30, 30) \
+  DWARF_REG(R31, 31)
+
+#define DWARF_PSEUDO_REGLIST
+
+/* Aliases */
+#define BP R8
+#define RA R1
+
+#endif

@@ -48,0 +49,18 @@
+
+  public static Address getRegFromSignalTrampoline(Address sp, int index) {
+    // ucontext_t locates at 2nd element of rt_sigframe.
+    // See definition of rt_sigframe in arch/riscv/kernel/signal.c in Linux Kernel.
+    Address addrUContext = sp.addOffsetTo(128); // sizeof(siginfo_t) = 128
+
+    // see arch/riscv/include/uapi/asm/ucontext.h
+    Address addrUCMContext = addrUContext.addOffsetTo(176); // offsetof(ucontext_t, uc_mcontext) = 176
+
+    // sc_regs in asm/sigcontext.h and asm/ptrace.h contains PC followed by x1-x31, not x0.
+    // RISCV64ThreadContext.PC (0) and R1-R31 (1-31) match the slot indices in uc_mcontext.sc_regs.
+    return switch(index) {
+      case RISCV64ThreadContext.PC, RISCV64ThreadContext.FP, RISCV64ThreadContext.LR,
+           RISCV64ThreadContext.SP, RISCV64ThreadContext.R5
+          -> addrUCMContext.getAddressAt(index * VM.getVM().getAddressSize());
+      default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported register index: " + index);
+    };
+  }
